findings.title: Missing React `key` on GrafanaRuleListItem in filtered list
findings.body: In the `rules.map(...)` render, the `grafana` branch returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` without `key={key}`, while all other branches pass a key. React will emit a key warning and, more importantly, lose element identity across incremental page loads of the infinite-scroll list, which can cause incorrect re-use/re-ordering of list item state as new batches are appended.

findings.title: Pause/Delete/Silence menu items still gated on rulerRule, so they never show in the list view
findings.body: The abilities are now computed from either the ruler rule or the Prometheus rule, but the rendering conditions were not updated: the Pause item requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123) and the Delete item requires `rulerRule` (line 165). Since the list view no longer fetches the Ruler API, `rulerRule` is undefined there and Pause/Delete will never render even when `canPause`/`canDelete` are true from the Grafana Prom abilities. This is a functional regression for the new rule list.

findings.title: Silence action is a no-op when only promRule is available
findings.body: `handleSilence` sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the list view `rule` (ruler rule) is undefined, yet AlertRuleMenu now enables the Silence item based on Grafana Prom abilities. Clicking "Silence notifications" will therefore do nothing at all.

findings.title: Federated rule-group check dropped; federated rules now appear editable/deletable
findings.body: `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` hardcodes `const isFederated = false` (replacing the previous `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` used by `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`). Federated Mimir rule groups were previously treated as immutable; now Update/Delete/Pause are reported as supported for them, exposing edit/delete UI for rules that cannot be modified. This affects the existing (non-list) views that use the deprecated hook too.

findings.title: `returnTo` query param dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleLoader` built the href as `createRelativeUrl(.../view, { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new component omits it, so navigating into a rule from the list and back loses the "return to previous" context.

findings.title: Loss of Creating/Deleting rule operation indicators
findings.body: Removing the Ruler query and `matchRules` means rules that exist in the Ruler but not yet in Prometheus (Creating) and rules removed from the Ruler but still in Prometheus (Deleting) are no longer surfaced; the former simply disappear from the group listing until Prometheus catches up. The tests for these behaviours were deleted rather than replaced, so there is no coverage of the new behaviour either.
